[i][b]Log Entry 004  Establishing a Base[/i]
Unit: 3rd Sikirskian Expeditionary Battalion
Log by: Colonel Ivanov
Time: 19:00 PM[/b]

[i]"First day, first steps. The perimeter is secure. Patrols are set. We have a command postnothing fancy, just a prefabricated structure with communications and supplies. Weve cleared land for an airstrip, though that will take weeks to finish. Civilians are setting up the first semi-permanent structures. Engineers are already discussing roads and fortifications. We dont know if were alone here, but were not leaving. Sikirsk has touched the mainland, and we intend to stay."[/i]

[b]The Grand Yugorsk Paper[/b]

Date: April 4th, 2025
Issue No. 95

[b]ELECTIONS DECLARED IN SIKIRSK[/b]

[b]A historic Vote to Shape the Future of the (Armed) Republic.[/b]

[b][i]- YUGORSK, SIKIRSK.[/i][/b]

The Sikirskian Central Administration has officially announced that national elections will be held on April 11th, 2025. This marks the first full civilian-led electoral process since the formation of the Armed Republic.

The announcement was made earlier today by Chairman John Kulmski of the Central Council, in a broadcast from the Sikirskian Parliament building in Yugorsk.

[i]The people of Sikirsk will finally shape the course of their own nationnot by force of arms, but through the will of the ballot, Chairman Kulmski said.
We stand at the door of a new future, built on complete unity, freedom, and liberalism.[/i]

[b]WHAT'S AT STAKE?
Sikirskians will vote for:[/b]

The National Council (legislative body)

Regional Governors across the confederations island provinces

The Supreme Executive Commandant  a civilian Commander-in-Chief to succeed the transitional military leadership

Because of the incomplete full intregration of the new mainland territories, there will be little to no voting on the mainland.

[b]IMPORTANT DATES[/b]

[i]April 4th-6th: Candidate Registration

April 7th: Debates Begin

April 9th: Early Voting Open

April 11th: Election Day (National Holiday)[/i]

[b]Security Notice:
The Ministry of Internal Order has assured the public that heightened security will be in place throughout the electoral process. Police and other ground forces are on standby to prevent any interference from foreign actors or internal unrest.[/b]

For continuous election coverage, analysis, and interviews, stay with The Grand Yugorsk Paper or on our new email system: https://boulderbugle.com/grandyugorskpaperemail-bX2lUONX (WORKS)

[u][i]Source: The Grand Yugorsk Paper Newspaper, 4th of April[/i][/u]

[b]----[/b]

[u][b]GLORY TO SIKIRSK![/b][/u]

[spoiler=[b][u]Stranded Far From Home.[/u]
Till we dream on a Sunrise.[/b]
[nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation] [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]]
[i]The night is heavy with the distant storm ceasing to be, breathing masks hang gently from their compartment with emergency lights glowing green to their exits.
660 souls including the crew of the aircraft with the only casualties being Pilot, co-pilot and a young flight attendee, as for the rest of the passengers would wake up to their natural senses to the scenario they now are in.
The reality of every man, woman and child on a island they know little about would become ever increasingly worrying, the chosen leaders of the survivors would take an hour's worth of calming down before a selected group was chosen.
This group of 8 to represent the 660 different people, spoke in their native tongue but know enough to understand one another well enough to work together.
With everyone still inside the aircraft, one of the doors had to be closed down as the cool breeze outside brought discomfort for the young.
The reason for the door and deployed inflatable ramp at the front of the aircraft was the act of not just 1, but of 13 panicked passengers who now are unknown to where they ran off to.
As the quietness develops for the now stranded people, all they can do is wait for the sun to rise...

But as a child looks out a window, she glimpsed at a strange light afar in the distance...
Before she could identify what she is looking at, it vanishes into the darkness of plain and empty landscape of sand and dry soil.
She'll be the only one who knows that every passenger on the Boeing 747 are all strangers in a strange land, and no one she knows would believe her warning. [/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b][u]Stranded Far From Home.[/u]
The Sands of Time.[/b]
[nation]Indonocaismnic[/nation] [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]
[nation]New Westmore[/nation]]
[i]The brightest light since the dawn of life awakes in the horizon, Ardagan, the sun of the solar system.
The light shines to uncover what is now pristine lands untouched by any man of the modern period, the clear ocean to the south, the extraordinary mountain and its significant but distinct landmark at its peak, to the west witj the golden dunes and to the east with dry but dancing forests.
The air is clean as the blue skys above, this place is unreal to be true but Mother Erene doesn't lie, her voice is true.

With the sun rising the plan is set in motion, a 100 individuals and another 100 more are both tasked to make to discover but also to collect resources to fill the stockpiles in the aircraft, the rest who stay are to do little tasks and not lose their sanity.
The first to discover is what has happened to the run away people, there where different shoe imprints in the soil and as the team of 20 followed them it became hard to distinguish as the enviroment appears to have masked them over short moment of time.
But this group had to consider splitting up to spread their search, for just 13 people out of 660, it shouldn't be too difficult...

And with their search, they managed to find them, not in the shape the folk wanted as the scream of a women who was part of the search team echoed the silence. 
Those who headed to the scream found her sobbing intensively with both hands covering her face, for what she has found her lover petrified and hollow, buried in the sand.
But that's not all as they dug around the corpse of a lover, more showed up, more dug their nails into the sands and with what they now see are 12 bodies.
All where petrified with what appears to be random deep cuts and deep holes over their bodies.
They were attacked by something in the night, something so viscous and cruel that it would bury the dead.
1 was however missing as it was found out amongst the corpses on blood soaked dirt, this concludes for a rather believable person as he speaks to them with consern, 
"What ever has killed these people is surely to return, like a squirrel burrying its nuts in the sand."
So they believed him, a mans theory is enough, so with the bodies they hold on makeshift sleds they carried, they would struggle with sorrow on their backs as the sands shift with time for the sun's light burns brightly...
The unseen sharks now swim the dunes to follow behind their prey with their prayers fulfilled by the grace of the sun.[/i][/spoiler]

Operation Skull has issued a rescue mission, with the Indonocaismnic government agreeing on any means to find the Jakitl Mecu Boeing 747 survivors. With Operation Skull, more than 60,000 active and 500 Special Indonocaismnic Forces have been deployed to Shaluik Island. Indonocaismnic government has supplied 32 CH-53G, 5 NH90 H145, and 3 Bell AH-1 Cobra in case of dangers. 600 VAB (Véhicule de l'Avant Blindé), 100 Otokar Cobra II and 500 Otokar Cobra I, 50 Humvee, 23 Stryker and 30 KAPLAN-30 IFV has been deployed in Shaluik Island with the attempt of searching the island for Jakitl Mecu Boeing 747 survivors. 

In the sea, the rescue patrol has sent out 2 Shikishima-class, 20 F2000-class Patrol Vessels, 5 KCR-40-class, 2 Sampari-class, 2 Parchim-class OPV, and 7 Cape-class. The core navy has also been deployed on 3 Carrier Ships, with 5 Frigates of 2 Type 130 "MKS 180" and 3 Sigma-class frigates.  About 5 Search planes have been sent, 2 British Aerospace Harrier II and 1 Eurofighter Typhoons, 2 Panavia Tornado (F-3). 

We have called upon the military of Indonocaismnic to find the missing Jakitl Mecu Boeing 747 survivors and bring them back home safely. We will try to find them and hope that their still some who make it out of the crash.-High Council[/i]
